title: A host-nation rehearsal can make allied movement coordination visible without proving crisis performance
source_unit: NATO Rapid Deployable Corps–Italy official account of Steadfast Discovery 26
geography: Copenhagen and Herning, Denmark; NATO Allied Reaction Force and Danish host-nation coordination

denominator.unit: officially reported Steadfast Discovery 26 Operational Liaison and Reconnaissance Team deployment rehearsal

rehearsal.unit: Operational Liaison and Reconnaissance Team deployment rehearsal

locations.unit: Danish locations named in the account

coordination_domains.value: logistics, transportation, movement, reception, and sustainment of allied forces
coordination_domains.unit: procedures and planning domains named in the account

authority_stakeholder_engagement.unit: direct engagement with Danish authorities and relevant stakeholders

real_crisis_performance.unit: movement speed, failure correction, civilian continuity, cost, and operational result under crisis conditions

observations.method: Review of the official NATO Rapid Deployable Corps–Italy public account of Steadfast Discovery 26; reported rehearsal activities are kept separate from independent performance measurement and civilian outcomes.
observations.uncertainty: The account describes a named rehearsal and coordination activities but does not report elapsed times, failed procedures, corrective actions, budgets, independent evaluation, civilian disruption, public opinion, or wartime performance.
observations.subgroup: NATO Allied Reaction Force personnel, Danish host-nation authorities and stakeholders, transport/logistics actors, and civilian systems implicated by movement and sustainment.
observations.counterinterpretation: A rehearsal can create real learning and improve future readiness even when its public account does not measure performance; lack of outcome data is not evidence that the activity had no value.

boundary: This record captures an official report of a NATO host-nation rehearsal and its named coordination domains. It does not establish actual deployment performance, civilian service continuity, local consent, cost sharing, legal terms, deterrence, or strategic effect.
